name: showdown-board-review
description: Read-only review of one Showdown board-zones candidate at a 40-hex expected_sha against base_sha, detached and clean. A gate refuses a wrong or malformed SHA, checks src/game/ is unchanged and builds the hosted page once; two parallel tracks run scripts/browser-showdown-board-zones.mjs --require-zones on that page (rules-flow: --only raise,raise-narrow plus npm test; privacy: --only trap), each with a --witness negative control that must exit 1 (break-pile, leak-name); a join maps results to .kiro/specs/showdown-board-zones IDs. Artifacts under .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/<sha>/. No edits, installs, pushes, posts, merges or schedules.

steps.prompt:
Candidate `{{expected_sha}}`, base `{{base_sha}}`. Read-only: no edits to tracked files, no npm install/ci, no npx, no push, PR, merge, post, schedule or Web. Write only under .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/. Run every command once, in the foreground, as its own shell call with a 10 minute timeout; do not background, poll or retry. Record literal command, exit code and the last two output lines. Never report a command you did not run.
If either SHA is not 40 lowercase hex, put it in no command: write `refused: malformed sha` to .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/refused.md and end the step with status error.
1 `git rev-parse HEAD` = candidate. 2 `git symbolic-ref -q HEAD` exits non-zero. 3 `git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all` prints nothing. 4 `git cat-file -e {{base_sha}}^{commit}` exits 0. 5 `test -f scripts/browser-showdown-board-zones.mjs`. 6 `node -e "require.resolve('playwright-core')"` exits 0 (if not, record `missing dependency: playwright-core`; do not install).
Any failure in 1-6: write .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/gate.md with each failing fact and verdict `refused`, end with status error. Do not checkout, stash, clean or install around it.
7 `git diff --name-only {{base_sha}} {{expected_sha}} -- src/game/` (BZ-12, must be empty; record paths). 8 `node scripts/build-graybox.mjs --hosted` (must print `build ` followed by the first 12 hex of the candidate). 9 `shasum -a 256 dist/web/index.html`. 10 `git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all` still empty.
Write .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/gate.md (step, command, exit, IDs, build label, sha256) and end the final response with one line `gate: open build=<12 hex> sha256=<64 hex>`, or `gate: fail` with status error if 7-10 failed.

branches.prompt:
Gate:
{{gate.output}}

Read-only: no edits to tracked files, no npm install/ci, no npx, no push, PR, merge, post, schedule or Web. Write only under .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/. Run every command once, in the foreground, as its own shell call with a 10 minute timeout; do not background, poll or retry. Record literal command, exit code and the last two output lines. Never report a command you did not run.
If the gate output does not end with `gate: open`, write .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/rules-flow.md `blocked: gate not open` and end with status error. Run `git rev-parse HEAD` (must equal {{expected_sha}}) and `shasum -a 256 dist/web/index.html` (must equal the gate sha256); if either differs write `refused: HEAD or page changed since gate` and end with status error.
P (positive): `node scripts/browser-showdown-board-zones.mjs --page dist/web/index.html --require-zones --only raise,raise-narrow --out .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/rules-flow/positive.json`. Match only if exit is exactly 0, output has `layout: zones (zones required)`, a PASS line for each of raise,raise-narrow, and the final `board zones: PASS` line shows revision = first 12 hex of the candidate and html sha256 = first 16 hex of the gate sha256. IDs BZ-01, BZ-04, BZ-06, BZ-07, BZ-08, BZ-02 (360px only).
W (negative control): `node scripts/browser-showdown-board-zones.mjs --page dist/web/index.html --require-zones --only raise,raise-narrow --witness break-pile --out .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/rules-flow/witness.json`. Match only if exit is exactly 1 and the final line is `board zones: FAIL · layout zones · witness break-pile` with the same revision and sha256. Exit 0 means the witness was not caught; exit 2 or any other code is a usage or harness fault; both are mismatch (RV-03).
N: `npm test`, match only on exit 0 (BZ-07, BZ-12).
Repeat the HEAD and sha256 checks. Write .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/rules-flow.md: table of id, command, expected exit, observed exit, revision, sha256 prefix, match or mismatch, IDs. Finish with status success after writing it, even with mismatches (the join decides). Final response: that table.
